description:
SAIC is seeking a Mid-Level Software Developer to support a government-owned, data-centric interoperability capability at Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC) Crane. This capability acts as a universal translation layer that lets sensors, effectors, cyber capabilities, and command and control (C2) systems exchange data regardless of vendor. 

  

 This position directly supports development of the common data schema, system adapters, software development kits (SDKs), application programming interfaces (APIs), and data pipelines using Agile and DevSecOps practices. The work spans laboratory integration, field demonstrations, and transition to a fielded program. The ideal candidate has hands-on Linux development experience and a strong background supporting Department of Defense (DoD) or Department of the Navy (DoN) programs, with a passion for delivering mission-critical capabilities to warfighters.

  

 Key Responsibilities

 
 
 Design, code, and test adapters that translate proprietary protocols from legacy and emerging sensors, effectors, cyber capabilities, and C2 systems into a common, vendor-neutral data format. Help expand and maintain the common data schema.


 
 Develop, document, and update developer-friendly SDKs and APIs that enable rapid, vendor-agnostic integration by government and third-party developers.


 
 Participate in the full software development lifecycle in an Agile/DevSecOps environment, including requirements analysis, design, coding, unit and integration testing, and documentation. Contribute to the Software Lifecycle Development Plan.


 
 Develop and maintain software in Linux-based environments using C, C++, Java, and/or Python. Check all code into government-controlled repositories (e.g., Bitbucket) and follow project coding standards.


 
 Support software builds, configuration management, and version control using Git, Jenkins, or similar CI/CD pipelines. Integrate automated unit testing, container scanning, and security vulnerability linting.


 
 Build, containerize (Docker or government-approved equivalents), and deploy cloud-ready applications, microservices, and adapters. Support Kubernetes orchestration, secure container registries, and the security controls for Authority to Operate (ATO) packages.


 
 Develop tools and dashboards that collect and report on performance and integration statistics. Analyze data flows to optimize message passing, reduce latency, and support backwards compatibility and interoperability.


 
 Support software verification in Live/Virtual/Constructive (LVC) and hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL) environments. Troubleshoot defects found in lab, test, and field events, and turn anomalies into backlog items and design changes.


 
 Follow change control and environment promotion practices (Dev/Test/Prod) and help prevent "code drift" while supporting controlled third-party adapter contributions.


 
 Produce and maintain technical documentation, including interface documentation, test plans and procedures, and technical data package inputs. Support developer-facing manuals and training materials.


 
 Collaborate with systems engineers, hardware engineers, and government stakeholders on software interfaces. Participate in software design reviews, test readiness reviews, post-test reviews, and technical meetings.


 
 Provide on-site technical support during integration events, demonstrations, and exercises.


 

 Required Qualifications
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline
 3 or more years of professional software development experience, including work on interface, integration, API, or data-translation software
 Prior experience working on-site at a Naval or DoD installation 
 Interim secret clearance with the ability to obtain a secret clearance. SAIC will sponsor the clearance process.
 Candidate must be a US Citizen
 Must be local to or willing to relocate to the Crane, Indiana area. This position is on-site at NSWC Crane.
  
 Preferred Qualifications
  
 Experience supporting DoD or DoN acquisition programs
 Experience integrating sensor, effector, weapons, or C2 systems, particularly interface, adapter, or middleware development
 Familiarity with data translation, message parsing, and sensor-to-shooter or kill-chain data workflows
 Experience with tactical data link protocols and communications systems (e.g., Link 16, CDL, TTNT, or similar)
 Familiarity with open-architecture approaches such as MOSA (and FACE, if applicable)
 Experience with containerization (Docker, Podman), Kubernetes, and secure or government cloud environments (e.g., AWS GovCloud), including ATO/RMF exposure
 Experience with CI/CD automation, including automated testing and container/vulnerability scanning
 Experience with LVC, simulation, or hardware-in-the-loop test environments
 Experience with FPGA or microcontroller firmware development
 Experience with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket) in an Agile environment
 Familiarity with model-based systems engineering (MBSE) and requirements traceability
 Experience writing developer documentation or technical training content
 Working knowledge of structured data formats and schemas (e.g., JSON, XML, Protobuf) and of building or consuming APIs. 
 Familiarity with software integration and testing methodologies, including automated testing in CI/CD pipelines
 Strong programming skills in C, C++, Java, and/or Python
 Experience with version control (Git or equivalent) and Agile development workflows using tools such
 Proficiency in Linux-based development environments (Red Hat, Ubuntu, CentOS, or similar)
 Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (e.g., TCP/IP) to support lab and field integration
 
 SAIC®  is a premier mission integrator focused on advancing the power of technology and innovation to serve and protect our world. Our robust portfolio of offerings across the defense, space, intelligence, and civilian markets includes secure high-end solutions in mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services. We integrate emerging technology, rapidly and securely, into mission critical operations that modernize and enable critical national imperatives. 
 
 

 We are approximately 23,000 strong; driven by mission, united by purpose, and inspired by opportunities. SAIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC has annual revenues of approximately $7.3 billion. For more information, visit  saic.com . For ongoing news, please visit our  newsroom .
